title: Slime Isa world (8 x 8 chunks, after A Link to the Past)

legend.chunks: the map is cut into chunks.cols x chunks.rows chunks, named by column letter and row number (A1 is the north-west corner)
legend.elevation: 0 to 4, a higher digit is higher ground; cliffs are drawn where it drops
legend.regionCells: one character per cell: a region's key, or '.' for none
legend.regions: key, id, name, color, chapter, status, world (the overworld scene id: world.<id>), interiors (scene ids off the grid), placeholder (true: built by godot/tools/build_region_worlds.gd and safe to rebuild), theme, boss, notes
legend.passages: written by godot/tools/build_region_worlds.gd: the openings between touching regions {a, b, x, y, w, h} in cells

regions.name: Slimeshire Meadow
regions.notes: The hub, in the middle of the world (the castle's place in the reference): the plaza ringed by water. Worms moved in, the smith left for his crystal mine, the Forge is cold until Pearl 2 comes home. The prologue (the Wellspring and the glade) lies in the south-west, between B4 and C4, and teaches the Spear; Yoi's home lies under Lili's west yard; Fatty's Lair, the worms' burrow, opens in Fatty's Hollow, a red-rock hill in D5 behind the old fort's field maze and a bridge of falling slabs; the old Thorn Guard gate there only a Roll beats. A grey fallen tree a Heavy Roll breaks lies across the Verdant Gate's road (D4) and another across the Market Hill road into Glimmerhill (C4's west edge). Release 1. C4 has a fenced level-1 plateau with north and south stairs; the river crosses the C4/D4 border. C5 has an expanded lake, a falling-plank bridge requiring the charged Roll, an island bomb cave, a ford islet and a jetty. Hearts hide in chests.

regions.name: Gloop Forest
regions.notes: East of the hub, as in the game (moved 2026-10-10): the Verdant Gate on level-1's east edge leads in. Choked with webs; the Matron's brood spreads. A maze of web walls on its east side, which only the Silk skin (the Matron's Pearl) passes, leads to the Crystal Caverns. Release 1. From the Wilds a second web maze is to lead in, which only the Silk skin passes; it waits for the release that opens the Wilds (walled off in Release 1, owner 2026-11-19). The Matron lives at the top of the Weaver Hollow, Chapter 2's dungeon; the Watch Oak's root gate in F4 is its way in (owner, 2026-10-16, question 133). The small Gloop Cavern behind the cracked clearing's sinkhole is the Goo Bomb's come-back secret, with one of the forest's heart quarters (question 18).

regions.name: Crystal Caverns
regions.notes: East of Gloop Forest, as in the game (moved 2026-10-10). The west half of the great mountain: caves through the rock. The smith runs the crystal mine, which the Crystal Colossus has blocked; in his ore cave on the falling-slab maze (the Spiral: rings round a central peak, 2026-11-21) he gives the Lantern. A dark maze the Lantern lights, and the Colossus's arena ringed by four braziers. Pearl 3 grants the Feral skin. Reached from Gloop Forest through the web-wall maze (the Silk skin; web walls across Gloop's web lane, 2026-11-20). Release 1 ends when the Colossus falls. From the Wilds a hill is to lead in, which only the Feral skin climbs; it waits for the release that opens the Wilds (walled off in Release 1, owner 2026-11-19).

regions.name: Volcano Ridge
regions.notes: The east half of the great mountain, around the crater. Gorge's prison; the rumbling comes from here. Cinder, the magma salamander, guards the slopes with the Lava skin's Pearl, the last skin, which opens the way into Gorge's crater (question 32).

regions.name: Frostpeak
regions.notes: Proposal: the great lake in the south-east, frozen, with snowy cliffs: ice physics and snow. Old Rimepaw, the polar bear, holds the Polar skin's Pearl: sure-footed on ice and every slippery surface, and a belly-slide Roll on ice (owner, 2026-10-16, question 32).

regions.name: Sticky Swamp
regions.notes: South of the hub (the Great Swamp's place). Slow mud, poison, rain, spider-slimes. Old Gullet, the catfish, holds the Swim skin's Pearl (owner, 2026-10-16, question 32).

regions.name: West village (open)
regions.notes: A second town (Kakariko's place). Its first part joins Release 1: the house of Burr the gatekeeper, where young Burr teaches the Roll, three or four more houses, a shop and a game to play. The rest comes in later releases.

regions.name: Northern ruins (open)
regions.notes: Moved north 2026-10-10 (Crystal Caverns took the east). Empty slot: a ruin maze on a plateau (the Eastern Palace's place). A dungeon region. Gale, the storm roc, holds the Cloud skin's Pearl: floating across gaps from a ledge and riding updrafts (question 32).

regions.name: Desert (open)
regions.notes: Empty slot: a desert walled by cliffs (the Desert of Mystery's place). Sandmaw, the great sand worm and Gorge's worm general, holds the Sand skin's Pearl: burrowing through soft sand, under sand walls and through quicksand (question 32).

regions.name: North Wilds
regions.notes: The connecting fields north of the middle row (the Wilds split in two 2026-10-10). The connecting zones: the fields, roads, rivers and ledges between the regions. Every region opens onto them, so the hub reaches all of them. Walled off for all of Release 1 by terrain, with no guard posts (owner, 2026-11-19; it was to open after the Crystal Colossus, with Thorn Guard posts closing the ways to the other regions, question 130): every way between it and Slimeshire, Gloop Forest, the Crystal Caverns and Glimmerhill is planted shut.

regions.name: South Wilds
regions.notes: The connecting fields south of the middle row: roads to the swamp, the desert and Frostpeak. Walled off for all of Release 1 by terrain, with no guard posts (owner, 2026-11-19; it was to open after the Crystal Colossus, with Thorn Guard posts closing the ways to the other regions, question 130): every way between it and Slimeshire, Gloop Forest, the Crystal Caverns and Glimmerhill is planted shut.

markers.label: Slimeshire plaza
markers.notes: The middle of the world

markers.label: The Wellspring
markers.notes: The prologue's lake, where the slime is born (owner, 2026-10-16): a pool of glowing goo ringed by forest, the first screen of the prologue in B4's south-west. The prologue's forest path from Slimeshire's south-west reaches it later; each Pearl comes home here

markers.label: Dora the Fishergirl
markers.notes: At the water around the plaza (renamed from Lily on 2026-10-11; the game says Dora since 2026-11-19)

markers.label: Fatty's Lair
markers.notes: The worms' burrow under the old Thorn Guard fort, in Fatty's Hollow, a red-rock hill in D5 behind the field maze and a bridge of falling slabs (built 2026-10-17, the mouth moved from D4 the same day): the drop gate a Roll beats, falling slabs over the void and spikes, Burr freed from his two-keyhole cell; Pearl 1 (the Heavy skin) in the Larder behind the Big Squint, and its take seals the Lair; the Heavy second half (the Weigh House, the big key), then Fatty One Eye, enraged, whose fall breaks the seals; out by the Postern (its chest holds coins and a potion), through a barricade a Heavy Roll breaks, by the bolt-hole near the Verdant Gate

markers.label: Plaza bridge
markers.notes: The old way out of Slimeshire into the Wilds, planted shut for Release 1 (the Wilds are walled off, owner 2026-11-19)

markers.label: Verdant Gate
markers.notes: level-1's east exit into Gloop Forest: the gate is long gone and a grey fallen tree lies across its road (D4 (1728, 752), `verdant-tree`); only a Heavy Roll breaks it (owner, 2026-11-19, question 163)

markers.label: Silk Nook Cave
markers.needs: Silk skin (the nook's web wall), Goo Bomb (cracked ground)

markers.label: Weaver Hollow
markers.notes: The Watch Oak, an old Thorn Guard watch fort inside a giant oak (built 2026-10-17, rebuilt one world per room 2026-11-25): a Goo Bomb blows its root gate; the Trunk, the Roots, the Boughs and the Crown; Pearl 2 (the Silk skin) in the Hoard behind the Brood Warden, whom a ram knocks flat, and its take seals the Hollow; the Silk second half (the Spinning Loft, the rafters, the big key), then the Orb-Weaver Matron in the Crown, brought down by its five rams; out by the Outer Bough's drop to the forecourt

markers.label: Web-wall maze
markers.notes: gloop-forest's east way into the Crystal Caverns: a maze of web walls only the Silk skin passes (owner, 2026-10-16); since 2026-11-21 (River Roads) a small maze of five web walls south of the Watch Oak's glade in F4, out at F4's east edge rows 26-27

markers.label: Crystal Mine
markers.notes: The smith's crystal mine, taken by the Crystal Colossus (built 2026-10-17): six dark rooms the Lantern teaches, the Foreman's Gate's two keyholes, the Chasm's lens for the Bow; Pearl 3 (the Feral skin) in the Den behind the Shardback, and its take seals the mine; the Feral second half (root walls to climb, the big key on a balcony), then the Colossus, enraged, in his arena of four braziers, climbing his wall; the climb out to the Lookout. Rebuilt one world per room (15 rooms, record id crystal-mine) and entered since the switch-over of 2026-11-25

markers.label: Gorge
markers.notes: Finale, in the crater

markers.label: West village
markers.notes: Burr's house (young Burr teaches the Roll), a few houses, a shop and a game: Release 1's part

markers.label: Ruin maze?
markers.notes: Empty slot: a dungeon

markers.label: Desert ruin?
markers.notes: Empty slot

markers.label: Yoi's home
markers.needs: Gulp away the heap of crates over the hatch in Lili's west yard (optional)
markers.notes: Old Veteran Yoi's den (slimeshire-yoi-home, under C4's heap hatch), his home after the prologue: Lili's tip finds it; his war tips, Slimeshire's fifth heart quarter and the Charged Roll in his chest (built 2026-11-20); later the Spear's upgrades

markers.label: The smith's cave
markers.notes: The smith's camp in his ore cave in the peak's face, on the falling-slab maze's main road (the Spiral, 2026-11-21): the Lantern and the Smith's Crystal; his lamp frees his one-way cart down to the mine's gate

markers.label: The glade
markers.notes: The prologue's second screen, in B4's south-east: Yoi falls to four worms; the slime saves him by throwing things and learns the Spear. A barred gate (the Spear's lock) opens onto a forest path to Slimeshire's west edge

markers.label: The Lookout
markers.notes: Daylight on the mountain in H4, where the climb out of the Colossus's arena arrives; a path down to the camp

markers.label: The Lair's bolt-hole
markers.notes: Fatty's Lair's way out (arrival only), by the Verdant Gate; Burr waits here after Fatty

markers.label: Fatty's Hollow
markers.notes: D5's red-rock hill, crowned with maples; the Lair's drop gate in a notch of its south face, over a paved forecourt (a campfire, an energy flower, a pot hiding a heart)

markers.label: Field maze and moat slabs
markers.notes: The old fort's field before the hill: a maze of fieldstone walls cut by a dry moat; two falling slabs cross it in one Roll, a walk falls back to the rim

markers.label: Hill crack
markers.notes: Goo Bomb opens hollow-hill-cave, a separate room hiding the grove heart in a chest.

markers.label: First bell and keeper storehouse
markers.notes: C4: the pond bell unlocks the keeper's timber storehouse. The coffer is inside a separate room with pots and stored supplies; nothing reveals the reward outside.

markers.label: Lookout bell
markers.notes: C5: a bell on a lookout rock; a pot thrown from its foot rings it and raises a hidden chest

markers.label: Old pen, grey planks
markers.notes: D4: Heavy Roll breaks the pen planks; the heart is hidden inside a chest.

markers.label: Lake island cave
markers.notes: Long falling planks with no landing; enemies, cracked rock, chests and pots. Future secret spot is empty.

markers.label: Town river bridge
markers.notes: Crossing the bridge crosses the C4/D4 chunk boundary.
